items.text: So we wanted to write something today that wasn't just a patch note. So we opted for the regular update option because we wanted to make sure you see it.

It's been great seeing your messages, your videos, your posts, but above all, your fun. Thanks for the support and faith you put in us.
We do try to reply to everyone, but even if we don't write, trust us, your messages, feedback, and reports are read.
OK, now that we did the emotional part, let's get down to the patch notes

We will, from this point on, be trying to do only 1 update per week (unless there is like an urgent issue ), so you don't need to have 4 updates per week as you had on this one. That and because the whole gang kinda needs to rest at some point.

items.text: So today we had a quite large update (in terms of file size) even tho there is no new content..yet ;)
This is most likely our last update before 0.4 being launched in a few days.
But why are we releasing this one now and not just wait?
A couple of reasons.

Number one is in the past 2 months, apart from creating the new content that is coming (both for 0.4 and 1.0), we have been working hard to improve the performance of the game for all. This was always a goal of ours, but with the current prices of Pc parts, we decided it was even more important than ever to make sure as many people as possible can enjoy the game without having to worry so much about their machine specs.
You should notice the game is now much more fluid as it uses less memory to run almost everything in the game.
Keep note that for those that have more powerful PCs, there is an option under video settings that allows you to preload all game assets for even more fluid gameplay (at the cost of some memory use)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612322/26265751f21ad8fa8bdcc2edc9c69787cb8f9ac1.jpg"]

Reason number 2 is that we want to make sure the optimizations we made don't affect your gameplay before the new content is out. Nothing is more annoying than new content being released, and you can't play it because the game now doesn't launch. So if you stumble into any issue in this update with the game not launching or crashing, contact us at our Discord - https://discord.com/invite/waterparksimulator or via our support email - support@cayplay.com

And related to that, it's the 0.4 download size. To make it faster on release day, if you update now, the new content update will be much smaller. Yeah, we want to make sure you get access to the 0.4 content as fast as you can, instead of looking at a large download bar ;)
Anyway, after this wall of text, here are the contents of this update
Major optimizations in memory use all over the game. The game will be lighter and easier to load with less memory used.
Restructuring of save files for more stability and compatibility with future updates.
NEW FEATURES
Option to preload all assets for a more fluid game at the cost of some memory use.
Save games if corrupt will now display in red in the load save menu to avoid any issues going unnoticed and spreading to the backups
We are already working on not only fixing some issues mentioned by you all, but also adding new features. So stay tuned.

items.text: Ok, I can tell you we did not get much in terms of rest this week ːsteamboredː
As you probably saw, we had to roll back yesterday's update 0.3.51 as it seems it caused some of you be locked outside of the game.
So we ended up with the following situation
We had 3 kinds of players

Players that the game would launch and had no crashes with both versions 0.3.4 and 0.3.51 (this is where we all of us here at Cayplay were, which makes it much harder to figure out what causes the other scenarios)
Players that version 0.3.40 would work but when updating to 0.3.51 it would not
Players that version 0.3.51 would work but not 0.3.40
Isn't making games so much fun and relaxing?
Anyway, we always try our best to give you guys the best experience we can offer. We believe this version should work as intended for everyone.
But just in case we have left 2 versions available to everyone. 0.3.40 and 0.3.51

To swap to any of these versions, you can right click on the game name in your library and choose properties (or its equivalent in your language). In the new window, choose "Game Versions & Betas" and choose the version you want. Steam will initiate an "update" (even tho it is actually going back a version).
KNOW ISSUES

It seems the latest Windows 11 updates have caused SAC (Smart App control) to block lots of apps that use the Unity engine (and yes, this includes games much bigger than ours). We are currently looking for solutions and even working with other game studios to find a solution for all of us.

During our tests today, we saw a case where trying to load a game, the cursor disappeared. Going back to main menu with Esc and choosing load again seems to fix it. We found the cause but did not want to delay this update anymore (for reference any time we do a new build, it might take up to 8 hours specially if we change too much how some parts of the game render)

items.text: We're excited to announce that version 0.3, the Wellness Update, is out. This is our first major content drop since we started Early Access. This update adds a whole new layer to your waterpark. You can create a zen-like retreat for guests to relax or, if you so wish, a place where turning a dial might just heat things up in some unexpectedly toasty ways.

Once your park reaches 3 stars, a new character will appear. You'll need to leave the park and go have a chat with the Yogi, who sets you along the path of enlightenment. This is a line of 21 wellness-themed quests. Some of them will most certainly tax your thinking as you attempt to interpret the Yogi's words of wisdom, but each step that you complete earns you new items for your park.

Finishing the full questline unlocks a large collection of new content. You will gain 9 new pools, 4 new slides, 5 new loungers, and 29 new decorations. The visual style of many of these items is so different that it can inspire a completely new park layout. There are also new mechanics to explore. Hot tubs and saunas give guests a relaxing break, for example, although adjusting the temperature a little too far can create quite a different experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612322/b81856623fb10afef90261108d8c60825e80b626.gif"]

To help bring it all together, the update also introduces a range of new painting styles: marble textures, transparent slide materials, shiny metallic finishes, and several more. We accept no responsibility for any irresistible urges to repaint your entire park.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612322/06c9edf3f79891ca0bdcf367f4141eca18e7a78f.gif"]

items.text: We also reworked the staff cap system. Many players asked for more flexibility if they so desired, and we are always happy to allow you guys to choose and play your way. So now you can hire staff above the previous limit. Going beyond this limit comes with an additional daily cost in the form of a tax, which turns staffing into a meaningful strategic choice rather than a hard restriction.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612322/606644cbf88cc1071ef0e2db775212372cdfa46d.jpg"]

To celebrate the release of the Wellness Update, Waterpark Simulator is part of the Black Friday sale. If you've been waiting to jump in or if you want to bring a friend along before the multiplayer is out, this is a great time.
We hope you enjoy building and experimenting with all the new features. Start your path of enlightenment now and create something truly Zen.

We are aware of a known issue where, under certain graphical settings, some of the transparent material (mainly the glass walls of the saunas and some painted tubes in slides) might look a bit different than planned. If you see this for now, you can change the video settings to high and then back to what you had, and it should fix it.
We already have a possible solution, but we did not want to delay the launch today since it is not game-breaking and will only affect some.
Your comments and feedback, as always, are welcome, so keep them coming. We want to create this game together with you, our players.
